candidates.claim: fw-01 allows SSH management from CORP 192.168.30.0/24 on the corp interface, which violates the management policy that device management is permitted only from MGMT 10.10.99.0/24 and, on fw-01, only on the mgmt interface.
candidates.remediation: Remove the SSH mgmt_access entry for 192.168.30.0/24 on the corp interface and restrict SSH management on fw-01 to 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface.

clarifications.question: fw-01 has the ASA HTTP server enabled (fw-01:109) and management access over the http service from 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface (fw-01:110). The policy requires HTTPS/ASDM management and disables IOS HTTP/HTTPS servers, but it does not state whether ASA plain-HTTP management is acceptable. Should fw-01 ASDM access be HTTPS only, and should the ASA HTTP server be disabled?
